text_block_list.text:
With the Mile Championship looming just ahead,
heading toward it—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Trainer-dono, please continue to oversee my running and provide instructions as you always do.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
As for the gift to the Princess... if I may be so bold,
I would like to prepare it myself.

If you say leave it to you, then I will believe in you.
The upcoming Mile CS is my chance for back-to-back victories.
"As the defending champion, run a race full of majesty." For him, that was his prime directive—and his courtly duty to the princess.
And on the day of the race—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"My King.
Let us hold our final war council before the race."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Please give me today's strategy.
Pray, guide me to victory.

I spread out the map of the racecourse
and explain the strategy.

I predicted how the other Umamusume would run,
and explained in meticulous detail how Durandal should make her cut.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
O King... you truly are certain, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: If we do it like this, victory is assured.
choice_data_list: Yeah, with this strategy and your running, without a doubt!
Yeah, with this strategy and your running, victory is guaranteed!

text_block_list.text: There is no hesitation. Understanding everything about Durandal and cultivating his power is what brought us here.

"I now knew everything there was to know about the 'Holy Sword.'
Durandal and I were as one."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Splendidly done... my King...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Ah, as expected... This is truly it...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No... all that's left is to show it in the race.
The brilliance of our master-and-servant bond.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'm off!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I've got high hopes for you!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Good day, Durandal.
I have been looking forward to this day.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The day our absolute best runs,
yours and mine, will overlap.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Yes, on this stage, I will definitely show everyone what the ideal master-servant bond looks like.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that—victory!
I shall raise my King to heights surpassing even you,
whom I so deeply revere.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, feeling confident, are we?
Even so, I have no intention of backing down.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Winning her final GⅠ was the ultimate bouquet to cap off these three years.
And then...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "A token of my deepest gratitude to the people back home waiting for me♪"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"It is precisely because the one I am contending with for it is you—
that it holds even greater value."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Then let us compete with honor.
To see who knocks the feather from the other's visor first.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Now is the time to duel! Upon this sword!
(WOOOAAAHH!)

To the princess embarking on her journey:
A dazzling, unforgettable strike to remember for a lifetime.

It is both a farewell and a blessing.
And a slash that heralds the dawn
of the Durandal era.
